ctx.x: And Horace Willard, radio technique and recording. Oh, here--CBS, it says. You said he was associated with one of the studios. And Maceo B. Sheffield, public relations.
Heh heh heh. I had to put him down as somethin'.
And Norman Siminoff, photography, and Dewey L. Johnson, radio productions. You told me earlier today that Norman Siminoff was a Jewish fellow who taught Sheffield photography. Is that right?
